sentences.en: Her acute observation skills make her a very suitable photographer.
sentences.zh: 她敏锐的观察力使她非常适合成为一名摄影师。

sentences.en: Anthropologists use interviews and participant observation to gain an emic.
sentences.zh: 人类学家通过访谈和参与式观察来获取内源性知识。

sentences.en: Observation is a passive science, experimentation an active science.
sentences.zh: 观察是一种被动科学，而实验则是一种主动科学。

senses.zh: 观察，监视；观察力；观察资料，观察结果；言论，评论；遵守，奉行；测天
